classification_rule.case_a: all matched Pass-only controls are materially stable and at least one isolated anywhere=true query produces a material change
classification_rule.case_b: matched Pass-only controls show material natural variation and every query remains within the anonymous control envelope
classification_rule.mixed: matched controls show material natural variation and at least one query exceeds the anonymous control envelope; causality remains unresolved
classification_rule.no_material_change: neither matched controls nor isolated queries produce a material change

privacy: public evidence contains types, ordinals, digests, counts, booleans, thresholds, aggregate deltas, and field categories only; no objectId, coordinates, exact poses, or spawn coordinates
